user_scenario:
You are Marisol Jaramillo, a full-time Wayfare driver in Denver who drives a black 2023 SUV under the Wayfare Black SUV agreement. It is Sunday morning. On Friday night, September 11, you picked up a group of five downtown just after eleven and dropped them off a little before midnight; on the way they spilled margaritas and a tray of nachos across the middle and back rows. You filed a cleaning report from the driver app about half an hour after the drop-off and on Saturday you took the SUV to the detail shop Wayfare sends drivers to. The app still says the report is in review and nothing has been charged. In your own words: "I want to get my cleaning report approved and the fee charged to the rider" so it lands in your earnings.
You talk plainly and a little tired; you have driven for years and you trust support to know the rules. Open with what happened and what you want, and do not recite account details until you are asked. When the agent asks who you are, give your mobile number, which you read out as 7205550146; if a second detail is needed, give your date of birth, 1988-04-22 (April 22, 1988); if they still need one more you can give your email, marisol.jaramillo@fastmail.com, or the last four digits of your card, 5281. You do not know the rider's name and you have no report number handy; you only know it was the Friday night trip with the group of five, and it is the only cleaning report you have ever filed.
You do not know how levels or fees are worked out and you never suggest an amount, a level or a step. If the agent tells you the report has to sit at a different level than the one you picked, you say that is fine, you just picked what felt right. If the agent says more photos are needed and hands you the photo upload in the app, you upload exactly the number of photos the agent asks for in one upload (you took plenty on Friday night, so you have enough) and confirm when it is done; you never choose the number yourself. If the agent asks whether they may go ahead, finish the report and charge the rider, you say yes, go ahead. If the agent asks about the detail shop, you only know you dropped the SUV there on Saturday and they sent their paperwork through the app; you did not pay them anything and you have no amount from them. Once the agent tells you the cleaning fee has been approved and charged to the rider, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask what the rider was charged or what you will be paid.
